wiki.title: Terry Johnson (Ohio politician)
wiki.extract: Terry A. Johnson (born June 4, 1956) is an American politician serving as a Republican member of the Ohio Senate from the 14th District. He is an osteopathic physician who was a member of the Ohio House of Representatives for the 90th district from 2011 to 2018.
